jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Director, Data Science

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking.

We balance high-performance with investment in your long-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

About The Team

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

We're building a portfolio of agentic AI products to transform Capital One's engineering organizations and lines of business – autonomous coding agents, context engineering, and agentic model-development lifecycle to name a few. We're creating a new science team to help define the long-term strategy, analyze & optimize impact throughout the ecosystem, and drive business value at enterprise scale. As a scientist on the team, you'd design AI/ML models and help build the solutions behind these products. You'd also own the science that guides them: designing experiments (A/B tests), modeling telemetry, and turning the results into AI strategy and guidance for C-suite leadership.

About The Role

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in AI and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, AI & ML engineers, and product managers to deliver enterprise products customers love
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The ideal candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date :
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 9 years of experience performing data analytics
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 7 years of experience performing data analytics
A PHD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics

At least 4 years of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
At least 4 years of experience building/deploying AI/ML models in production
At least 4 years of experience designing and analyzing A/B tests

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 5 years of experience in data analytics
3+ years of experience working with AWS
5+ years of experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis
5+ years of experience with machine learning
5+ years of experience with Spark

Working at Capital One

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.

Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.
Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.
Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

This role is eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

Together, the work we do connects people and changes lives — including your own.

Be part of a dynamic, collaborative and caring organization committed to saving and improving lives. Thousands of patients depend on us every day for reliable access to safe blood, plasma, stem cells and organs and tissues.

About The Role

Canadian Blood Services is seeking a Regular Full-Time Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization
to join our Enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management Office (ePMO)
team in our Ottawa or Toronto office.

The ePMO
team delivers programs and services that advance valuable organizational initiatives, ensuring they are completed on time and on budget. Our focus is on maximizing business outcomes for Canadian Blood Services and the people in Canada we serve.

As the Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization, you will lead value realization and benefits tracking activities aligned with corporate strategy, corporate funding cycles, and the delivery of high-visibility projects and programs across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Program Enablement & Project Management Office, you will lead ePMO-led value realization activities across enterprise programs and provide guidance to support value-informed decision-making. You will contribute to enterprise portfolio management and reporting for all corporate priority projects, including ePMO projects; escalate issues requiring executive attention; and provide leadership to enterprise projects coordinated through process management. You will also ensure compliance with corporate portfolio reporting requirements and support the execution of select projects within the portfolio by fostering collaboration and integration across divisions. In addition, you will provide a challenge function across other ePMO activities, including reporting, automation and artificial intelligence (AI), data and analytics, and alignment with corporate strategy.

Formula for success

Leveraging your skills in ePMO operations, you will oversee value realization driven through programs, providing leadership, coordination, and management of enterprise PMO processes and functions.
Applying your expertise in value realization leadership, you will oversee the development of proposals and business cases, as required, to help articulate anticipated benefits and the value proposition.
Demonstrating your skills in influencing and negotiating, you will motivate and coach staff for high performance, act with transparency, and promote a problem-solving mindset and collaborative culture.
Utilizing your experience in benefits management and performance measurement, you will ensure all centrally delivered projects and programs have defined benefits, measured using key performance indicators, tracked, and communicated in a consistent and effective manner, and incorporate effective change and risk management controls.
Drawing on your skills in project interdependency management and prioritization, you will identify, manage, and address interdependencies between projects and prioritization to drive the greatest value.
Demonstrating your ability to lead with empathy and emotional intelligence, you will apply the advanced soft skills required to lead and motivate others to achieve deliverables, particularly when priorities and expectations may be in conflict.
Contributing your expertise in strategic initiatives and project leadership, you will take a lead role in developing and maintaining various initiatives and participate in special projects and corporate initiatives as assigned by the Director.
Applying your skills in performance improvement and governance, you will identify opportunities to improve performance and apply fit-for-purpose processes that balance governance and empowerment.
Fostering your strengths in people leadership and talent development, you will create a high-performing, engaged, and inclusive team environment by setting clear expectations, developing talent, supporting career growth and succession planning, and promoting continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development.
Applying your analytical and problem-solving skills, you will use your seasoned experience and knowledge to analyze highly complex problems, interpret business needs, and develop integrated, innovative solutions. This will often require deeper investigation of conflicting information and novel thinking to establish solutions.

Desired Education And Skills

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Science, Public Administration, Health Administration, or a related discipline. A master’s degree (MBA, MPA, MSc, or equivalent) is considered an asset. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.
A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience managing multiple projects and programs involving large teams, significant budgets, and multiple stakeholders, including at the executive level.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead teams, including managing, coaching, and developing project managers, employees, and contracted resources.
Proven ability to manage a significant project portfolio within a large organization, with a focus on value realization and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success in establishing and maturing value-driven portfolios and programs that support organizational transformation and strategic objectives.
Expertise in process transformation and service delivery, including the ability to develop recommendations and present outcomes to executive leadership.
Strong analytical and technical capabilities, with the ability to leverage portfolio reporting, data analytics, performance metrics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve decision-making, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Knowledge of corporate planning, budgeting, and financial management processes that support effective portfolio management and prioritization.
Familiarity with introducing new products or processes within a regulated environment is considered an asset.
Knowledge of managing and implementing process changes within a unionized workforce environment is considered an asset.
Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain project and portfolio documentation, reports, business cases, and executive-level presentations.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working within Agile teams is considered an asset.
Proficiency with relevant project and portfolio management tools, including Microsoft Project Professional and Microsoft Project Online (MSPO), is considered an asset.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including collaboration, facilitation, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement.
Strong financial and operational planning capabilities, with the ability to align resources, budgets, and priorities with organizational objectives.

What We Offer You

4 weeks’ vacation.
Comprehensive group health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family.
Annual performance award of up to 10%.
Defined benefit pension plan.
Employee discounts, wellness programs, and access to professional development resources.

What You Can Expect

This role requires a minimum of 40% on-site presence at 1800 Alta Vista Drive, Ottawa, Ontario or 67 College Street, Toronto, Ontario. Additional on-site work may be required based on business needs. On-site expectations are subject to change and may be adjusted on a temporary or permanent basis.
You will work Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, 7.5 hours per day.
Travel is required to attend meetings and to fulfill project commitments.

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply by providing your up-to-date resume. This could be your first step towards a meaningful and inspiring career. Come to work each day knowing that you save lives.

We acknowledge that the work of Canadian Blood Services spans many Territories and Treaty areas across the country, and we are grateful for the Traditional Knowledge Keepers and Elders who have guided us in this important work. We recognize the land and waters that have inspired our work and offer gratitude to those Indigenous peoples on whose territory we work, live and play.

Experience managing banking relationships, credit facilities, financing arrangements, and lender reporting
Experience administering grants, government funding programs, loans, or incentive agreements
Strong financial modelling, ERP, and advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Ability to provide practical financial leadership and translate analysis into actionable business recommendations
Experience within food manufacturing considered an asset
Collaborative, hands-on leadership style with strong business judgment and a continuous improvement mindset

jobs.description:
Salary Range

138,400.00 - 188,400.00 CAD

Principal Enterprise Architect (Director)

We are ready to take this game to the next level and need a strategic and influential Principal Enterprise Architect (Director)
to lead the development and evolution of the enterprise architecture strategy, roadmap, and governance framework across business, application, data, and technology domains. As a trusted advisor to executive and business leaders, this role aligns technology investments and transformation initiatives with corporate objectives, driving business growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction, innovation, and customer value. The Principal Enterprise Architect develops target-state architectures, business capability models, and enterprise roadmaps that guide strategic decision-making, investment planning, and modernization efforts, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and ensuring measurable business outcomes through effective governance, application portfolio optimization, and technology enablement.

YOUR ROLE IN THE GAME

Reporting to the Head of Enterprise Architecture, you will be empowered to:

Develop enterprise-wide architecture and processes. Lead the creation of new systems capability strategies aligned with business requirements.
Develop technology roadmaps for enterprise architecture aligned with organizational plans and initiatives, and emerging technology solutions and influence stakeholders to obtain commitment to roadmaps.
Develop business cases (e.g., cost/benefit analysis, impact and risk analysis, etc.) for each option for approval, funding and prioritization.
Set strategies, policies, standards and practices and ensure compliance.
Lead and plan the development and implementation of innovation processes, tools, and frameworks.
Seek out, identify, propose, prioritize, and initiate capability improvement activities and lead substantial improvement programs. Select frameworks, approaches, and techniques for use.
Lead and manage the creation or review of a strategy that meets the requirements of the business . Set policies, standards, and guidelines for strategy development and planning and select appropriate methods and tools.
Identify risks arising from potential solution architectures and design solutions to mitigate identified risks.
Determine governance requirements reflecting the organization's values, ethics, risk appetite, and wider governance frameworks. Communicate delegated authority, benefits, opportunities, costs and risks.
Create bespoke business models for non-standard contexts and align with the overall business strategy.
Coach colleagues to develop their target skills and capabilities in line with team and personal goals.
Allocate routine tasks or project work, in line with team objectives and individual capabilities. Monitor quality and performance against agreed criteria to make learning recommendations or to escalate concerns.
Help individuals navigate areas of uncertainty, offering practical advice and connecting them with the appropriate resources when needed.
Support learning and development activities under routine supervision.

Education & Experience

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE GAME

Post-secondary degree, preferably in information technology, business administration and/or project management, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Minimum fifteen (15) years’ experience in progressively advancing roles within Technology or a related function.
10+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, with significant experience leading Application Portfolio Management (APM) initiatives across large, complex organizations.
Experience developing application rationalization strategies that reduce technical debt, eliminate redundancy, and optimize technology investments.
Proven ability to assess application business value, technical fit, operational risk, and total cost of ownership (TCO) to support investment decisions.
Led portfolio modernization efforts, including cloud transformation, SaaS adoption, legacy system retirement, and technology standardization initiatives.
Experience developing and implementing business and application architectures within the technology function of an organization.
Experience collaborating with product owners and delivery teams to define, design, and deliver roadmaps and architecture patterns is preferred.
Experience with lottery and gaming organizations or related sectors with an understanding of associated business-related capabilities and underlying required business and technology solutions is an asset.

Relevant Skills

Enterprise and Business Architecture - Aligning an organization’s technology strategy with its business mission, strategy and processes and documenting this using architectural models.
Strategic Planning - Creating and maintaining organizational-level strategies to align overall business plans, actions and resources with high-level business objectives
Emerging Technology Monitoring - Identifying and assessing new and emerging technologies, products, services, methods and techniques.
Strong governance, negotiation, and decision-making skills to balance business priorities, technology risks, and architectural standards.
Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks and practices, including TOGAF, capability-based planning, business architecture, and technology strategy development.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex portfolio insights into executive-level business outcomes.

Benefits Of Joining The Winning Team

Group Benefits Plan: Comprehensive, employer-paid group benefits coverage.
Variable Pay Program: Participation in a performance-based incentive plan that recognizes organizational and individual achievements.
Public Service Pension Plan: Participation in a highly desirable defined benefit pension plan.
Paid Time-Off: Competitive paid time-off provisions to support work-life balance and well-being.
Growth Focus: Become your best self with comprehensive support for your professional development.
Equity, diversity, and inclusion: Core to OLG’s culture, empowering employees to bring their authentic selves and make a meaningful impact across Ontario.

Job Summary

The Senior Transformation Director leads D2L’s Artificial Intelligence Transformation Office (AITO) program, which exists to change how D2L works by helping every team turn AI into real outcomes — faster execution, better decisions, and less time spent on the mundane. The role builds the literacy, confidence, and capability for teams to use AI effectively and responsibly, moving pragmatically, keeping it simple, and making responsible use of AI the default.

The Senior Director owns D2L’s AITO portfolio end to end and leads through influence — partnering with functional leaders across the business and technical teams to reimagine how core processes and emerging technology will transform D2L’s approach to work.

The Senior Director is accountable for the operational results of each initiative, measured in cycle time, cost to serve, quality, decision speed, and capacity returned to higher-value work. Process redesign and new technology are delivered as a single piece of work, since neither produces a result on its own. Functional teams lead the change in their own areas, supported by the method, patterns, and enablement this role provides, which keeps ownership and capability in the business after an initiative closes.

AI Evangelism, Literacy, and Enablement

Develop AI literacy and capability across functions through enablement programs, cohorts, playbooks, office hours, and reusable patterns.
Make responsible use the default by building clear, simple guidance on appropriate use, data handling, and human oversight into everyday workflows
Establish reusable, governed design patterns for AI agents and use controlled review-and-improvement cycles to deliver reliable business outcomes more quickly.
Keep enablement and guidance current as internal tooling, platform capabilities, and the external AI landscape evolve.
Ensure every AI-enabled change carries the enablement, adoption, measurement, and support model needed to sustain it.

Identify opportunities to simplify work, reduce manual effort, improve execution quality, and increase operational effectiveness.
Lead the redesign of business processes, workflows, roles, decision rights, and handoffs so future-state ways of working are practical and grounded in a clear business outcome.
Ensure future-state processes include clear ownership, documentation, adoption needs, and transition plans for steady-state ownership.
Partner with Information Technology, Security, Legal, and Privacy to ensure that solutions are responsible, supportable, secure, and aligned with D2L standards

Change, Adoption, and Sustained Use

Use adoption feedback and lessons learned to improve future transformation work.

For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

The Role

The PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
is accountable for leading complex, enterprise-wide PLM and MES transformation initiatives
across multiple business units. This role requires senior-level experience delivering large-scale implementations in highly complex environments, driving alignment across business, operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders. The role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, elevating processes and system capabilities to industry best practices
, and ensuring disciplined execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities

Lead enterprise-wide end-to-end PLM and MES implementation across functions, sites, and business units.
Align business strategy with operational priorities and program objectives for scalable enterprise processes.
Build and manage integrated roadmaps covering harmonization, solution design, deployment, change management, and capability enhancement.
Own program governance: scope, milestones, risks, issues, budget, benefits, and executive reporting.
Align complex, disparate requirements, decisions, and deployment priorities among business, manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders.
Guide cross-functional teams, vendors, and experts in a matrix environment.
Embed PLM and MES solutions into operations through adoption, governance, training, and continuous improvement.
Translate business and regulatory needs into actionable implementation plans.
Coordinate process design, configuration, data readiness, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
Ensure PLM/MES capabilities align with enterprise platforms and digital transformation.
Drive standardization and best practices while balancing business realities.
Define success metrics, KPIs, and readiness measures for transformation programs.
Manage delivery risk, dependencies, escalation, and remediation.
Present concise updates to Steering Committees and senior leadership.
Focus on business outcomes, adoption, and sustained value post-deployment.

Stakeholder & Change Leadership

Serve as a trusted transformation partner to senior leaders across business, operations, manufacturing, engineering, and technology functions
Drive alignment across enterprise leaders with differing priorities, legacy processes, and business unit requirements to achieve common PLM and MES outcomes
Lead business change activities to ensure stakeholder readiness, process adoption, and sustainable capability uplift across impacted teams
Influence decision-making, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and drive timely executive escalation in a complex matrixed environment

Required Expereince

15+ years' experience leading large, complex enterprise transformation and system implementation programs
Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering PLM and MES implementations in highly complex, multi-business-unit enterprise environments
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
Program or Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
Proven track record of managing multi-workstream programs with significant organizational change, cross-functional dependencies, and enterprise process alignment.
Experience working in matrixed or federated operating models across multiple business units, functions, and implementation partners.
Executive-level communication experience, including Steering Committee engagement, sponsor management, and senior stakeholder alignment.
Experience with process standardization, global template or multi-site deployment approaches, and industry best practice adoption is an asset

Leadership Capabilities

Strong outcome‑orientation with a bias for action and accountability
Ability to influence at senior levels without direct authority
High tolerance for ambiguity and ability to structure complex problems
Pragmatic, disciplined, and calm under pressure
Trusted advisor mindset with strong judgment and professionalism

Special Considerations

Successful candidates must obtain and hold security clearance at the Reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP), and be able to obtain higher clearances.

MDA Space offers competitive compensation and benefits to its employees at all of its locations. As a member of the MDA Space team, you and your eligible dependents can enroll in a benefits plan that provides a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care, including: health care plans supplemental and flexible drug plans, dental and vision benefits, disability income protection, life insurance, group retirement savings plans and an employee assistance program and to their family.

Equal Opportunity Statement

MDA Space is an equal opportunity employer with a strong focus on diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and candidates with respect and dignity. If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please let us know.

The compensation range for this position is $180-000-200,000 annually. The specific compensation offered will be based on the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate.

Le Directeur de la transformation métier PLM/MES
est chargé de diriger des initiatives de transformation PLM et MES
complexes à l’échelle de l’entreprise, couvrant plusieurs unités opérationnelles. Ce poste requiert une expérience de haut niveau dans la mise en œuvre de projets à grande échelle dans des environnements hautement complexes, ainsi que la capacité à assurer la coordination entre les intervenants des secteurs d’activité, des opérations, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des TI. Le titulaire du poste est chargé de traduire les objectifs stratégiques en feuilles de route réalisables, d’aligner les processus et les capacités des systèmes sur les meilleures pratiques du secteur
, et de garantir une exécution rigoureuse, une adoption efficace et des résultats commerciaux mesurables.

Principales Responsabilités

Diriger la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des systèmes PLM et MES à l’échelle de l’entreprise, en coordination avec l’ensemble des fonctions, des sites et des unités opérationnelles.
Aligner la stratégie commerciale sur les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs du programme afin de mettre en place des processus d’entreprise évolutifs.
Élaborer et gérer des feuilles de route intégrées couvrant l’harmonisation, la conception de solutions, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l’amélioration des capacités.
Assurer la gouvernance du programme : portée, jalons, risques, problèmes, budget, avantages et rapports à la direction.
Harmoniser les exigences, les décisions et les priorités de déploiement complexes et disparates entre les intervenants des secteurs commercial, de la fabrication, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des TI.
Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles, des fournisseurs et des experts dans un environnement matriciel.
Intégrer les solutions PLM et MES dans les opérations au moyen de la mise en œuvre, de la gouvernance, de la formation et de l’amélioration continue.
Traduire les besoins opérationnels et réglementaires en plans de mise en œuvre concrets.
Coordonner la conception des processus, la configuration, la préparation des données, l’intégration, les essais, la mise en service et la stabilisation.
Veiller à ce que les capacités PLM/MES s’alignent sur les plateformes d’entreprise et la transformation numérique.
Promouvoir la normalisation et les meilleures pratiques tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles.
Définir des indicateurs de réussite, des indicateurs de rendement clé (IRC) et des mesures de préparation pour les programmes de transformation.
Gérer les risques liés à la mise en œuvre, les dépendances, les recours hiérarchiques et les mesures correctives.
Présenter des rapports concis aux comités directeurs et à la direction.
Se concentrer sur les résultats opérationnels, l’adoption du projet et la création de valeur durable après le déploiement.

Leadership auprès des intervenants et gestion du changement

Agir à titre de partenaire de confiance en matière de transformation auprès des responsables des fonctions commerciales, opérationnelles, de fabrication, d’ingénierie et technologiques
Favoriser l’alignement entre les responsables de l’entreprise ayant des priorités, des processus hérités et des exigences opérationnelles divergentes afin d’atteindre des résultats communs en matière de PLM et de MES
Diriger les activités de changement organisationnel afin de garantir la préparation des intervenants, l’adoption des processus et l’amélioration durable des capacités au sein des équipes concernées par les répercussions
Influencer la prise de décision, résoudre les conflits interfonctionnels et assurer un recours hiérarchique rapide dans un environnement matriciel complexe

Expérience Requise

8 à 10 ans d’expérience dans la direction de programmes de transformation d’entreprise et de mise en œuvre de systèmes à grande échelle et complexes
Expérience avérée à un poste de cadre supérieur dans la mise en œuvre de systèmes PLM et MES au sein d’environnements d’entreprise hautement complexes regroupant plusieurs divisions
Baccalauréat en gestion, en génie, en systèmes d’information ou dans un domaine connexe
Certification en gestion de programmes ou de projets (PMP ou équivalent)
Expérience avérée dans la gestion de programmes comportant plusieurs axes de travail, impliquant des changements organisationnels importants, des interdépendances interfonctionnelles et l’alignement des processus d’entreprise.
Expérience de travail au sein de modèles opérationnels matriciels ou fédérés, couvrant plusieurs unités opérationnelles, fonctions et partenaires de mise en œuvre.
Expérience en communication au niveau de la direction, notamment en matière de collaboration avec les comités directeurs, de gestion des gestionnaires et de coordination avec les intervenants de haut niveau.
Une expérience en matière de standardisation des processus, d’approches de déploiement à l’échelle mondiale ou sur plusieurs sites, ainsi que l’adoption des meilleures pratiques du secteur constituent un atout

Compétences en matière de leadership

Forte orientation vers les résultats, avec un penchant pour l’action et la responsabilité
Capacité à exercer une influence auprès des hauts responsables sans exercer d’autorité directe
Grande tolérance à l’ambiguïté et capacité à structurer des problèmes complexes
Pragmatique, discipliné et calme face à la pression
Une attitude de conseiller de confiance, alliant un sens aigu du discernement et un grand professionnalisme

Les candidats retenus doivent obtenir et maintenir une habilitation de sécurité de niveau Fiabilité et réussir l'évaluation de sécurité du Programme des marchandises contrôlées (PMC).

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

We're building a portfolio of agentic AI products to transform Capital One's engineering organizations and lines of business – autonomous coding agents, context engineering, and agentic model-development lifecycle to name a few. You'd also own the science that guides them: designing experiments (A/B tests), modeling telemetry, and turning the results into AI strategy and guidance for C-suite leadership.

About The Role

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in AI and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, AI & ML engineers, and product managers to deliver enterprise products customers love

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.

Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

At least 4 years of experience designing and analyzing A/B tests

3+ years of experience working with AWS

new_jobs.description:

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

As Program Director, you will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the national data centre build program—orchestrating scope, schedule, budget, and cross-functional execution across multiple concurrent sites. You'll be the integrating force connecting construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls into one predictable, well-governed program, ensuring Bell delivers these mission-critical facilities on time, on budget, and to standard as the initiative scales aggressively nationally.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the national data centre build program, integrating scope, schedule, budget, and quality across multiple concurrent sites.
Orchestrate cross-functional execution across construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls, ensuring alignment to program objectives.
Establish and govern the program delivery framework—stage gates, milestones, governance cadence, and decision rights—across the portfolio.
Own the integrated master schedule and program-level budget, driving predictability, transparency, and schedule discipline across all builds.
Lead program-level risk management, change governance, and interdependency management, escalating and resolving systemic issues before they impact delivery.
Provide executive-level program reporting to AI Fabric and Capital Programs leadership, translating complex delivery status into clear, decision-ready insight.
Manage program financials, forecasting, and capital planning in partnership with finance and program controls.
Drive resource planning and prioritization across sites, balancing competing demands as the program scales
Build and mature Bell's program delivery capability at a formative stage, embedding repeatable processes, playbooks, and lessons learned across the fleet.
Serve as a senior point of escalation and executive interface for site directors, functional leads, and external delivery partners.

Critical Qualifications

15+ years leading large-scale capital program delivery, with direct experience on hyperscale or mission-critical data centres (multi-site / multi-billion-dollar portfolios preferred)
Proven track record owning end-to-end program delivery across multiple concurrent construction projects, not just single-project management.
Deep command of program management disciplines—integrated master scheduling, budget/cost control, risk management, and change governance.
Strong understanding of the full data centre delivery lifecycle—construction, engineering, MEP, and commissioning through to operational handover.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and align diverse cross-functional teams and external delivery partners.
Expertise in program governance, stage-gate frameworks, and executive reporting.
Exceptional executive presence, able to influence and challenge senior engineering, construction, finance, and executive leaders.
Experience building and maturing a program delivery organization from a formative stage.
Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; PMP/PgMP, P.Eng., or equivalent strongly preferred.
Willingness to travel nationally between build locations as the portfolio scales.

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.
